normalization.interval: t=(x-m)/w; G0_t=C^T G0_x C; G1_t=w^2 C^T G1_x C

reconstructed_identities.name: I2 NATURAL INTERVAL SOS
reconstructed_identities.identity: For x=m_h+w_h*t, m_h=(beta_h+L_h)/2 and w_h=(L_h-beta_h)/2: x*p_h(x)-1=u(t)^T*G0_{t,h}*u(t)+(1-t^2)*v(t)^T*G1_{t,h}*v(t), with G0_t=C_h^T*G0_x*C_h and G1_t=w_h^2*C_h^T*G1_x*C_h.

reconstructed_identities.name: I3 NEWTON-RADAU DUAL
reconstructed_identities.identity: For contacts z=(beta,t1,t1,...,t_{K-1},t_{K-1}[,L]): p(x)=sum_{k=0}^{|z|-1} ((-1)^k/prod_{r=0}^k z_r)*prod_{r=0}^{k-1}(x-z_r).  Hence pure: x*p-1=(x-beta)*prod_i(x-ti)^2/(beta*prod_i ti^2); L-contact: x*p-1=(x-beta)*(L-x)*prod_i(x-ti)^2/(beta*L*prod_i ti^2).

reconstructed_identities.name: I4 RANK-ONE MARKOV-LUKACS
reconstructed_identities.identity: With tau_i=(t_i-m)/w and P(t)=prod_i(t-tau_i), pure: T=C_h*(t+1)*P(t)^2=(C_h/2)*((t+1)P(t))^2+(1-t^2)*(C_h/2)*P(t)^2; L-contact: T=C_h*(1-t^2)*P(t)^2.  The normalized Gram weights are therefore exactly (1/2,1/2) or (0,1).

reconstructed_identities.name: I5 SOURCE-MOMENT RADAU RECURRENCE
reconstructed_identities.identity: For <x^i,x^j>=nu_{i+j}, the monic recurrence has alpha_k=<xP_k,P_k>/<P_k,P_k> and beta_k=<P_k,P_k>/<P_{k-1},P_{k-1}>; the Radau final diagonal is the unique rational modification making beta a root.  Thus its characteristic polynomial and rule value are exact rational functions of beta and nu_0..nu_{2K-2}.

reconstructed_identities.name: I6 FLOOR/CEILING LDL
reconstructed_identities.identity: B_h-beta_h*I=L_{-,h}*D_{-,h}*L_{-,h}^T and L_h*I-B_h=L_{+,h}*D_{+,h}*L_{+,h}^T exactly; under mu1 scaling the pivots are D_{+/-}/mu1 and the unit-lower multipliers are unchanged.

unified_form.identity: Let y_h=B_h^{-1}b_h, C_s=[[1,-y_h^T],[0,I]], r_h=n_h-sum_j c_{j,h}nu_{j,h} and delta_h=b_h^T(p_h(B_h)-B_h^{-1})b_h.  Then exactly M_h=C_s^{-1}diag(r_h+delta_h,B_h)C_s^{-T}, with r_h>=eta*n_h on every packaged cell.  The SOS identity gives B_h*p_h(B_h)-I=S0_h(B_h)+(B_h-beta_h I)(L_h I-B_h)S1_h(B_h) >=0 (commuting polynomial factors), hence delta_h>=0; and B_h=beta_h I+L_{-,h}D_{-,h}L_{-,h}^T.  This is the sharp common PSD decomposition schema. It is NOT the dream closed h-form because beta_h, L_h, the floor-LDL multipliers, rounded Radau contacts, Chebyshev coefficients/Grams, and y_h have no exact closure in the allowed variables on this corpus.
h_closure_requires: exact beta_h and L_h in the allowed variables
exact Radau characteristic/contact data without dyadic node rounding
honestly_local: the exact dyadic floor beta_h and ceiling L_h
the normalized floor/ceiling LDL pivot and unit-lower values
the rounded rational Radau contact nodes and numerical weights
all dense Chebyshev majorant coefficients and SOS Gram entries
